### 🌐 Multiplayer stability
- Fixed matches falling apart after a few minutes: players no longer vanish from each other's game (or get kicked with "host left") when an idle connection to the matchmaking server times out mid-match
- Stale rooms whose host is long gone no longer show up in the room browser, so joining a listed room actually connects you
- Other players now move smoothly instead of juddering and rubber-banding — especially at high frame rates and on connections with jitter
